detailed_descriptions.en: Are you ready to protect your city? In Superhero Simulator , take on the rising crime rate as you patrol the streets, stop robberies, rescue civilians, and battle powerful villains. Your choices shape the city! SAVE THE CITY Stop robberies, rescue civilians, and fight crime your way. Every heroic act unlocks new abilities - become the hero Goldpine needs! MANAGE YOUR DAILY NEEDS Being a hero doesn’t pay the bills—so you’ll need a job to survive. Drive a taxi, flip burgers, or find other ways to earn money Every "Gollar" counts, whether it’s for food, or upgrading your gear. Balance your heroic duties with everyday struggles. CUSTOMIZE YOUR HERO Design your perfect superhero AND civilian identity! Mix and match masks, capes, and armor sets to create your signature look. Your hero, your style, your legend. RISE OR FALL Manage your health, hygiene, mental state, and respect to stay at your best. Neglect them, and your journey becomes harder. Every action shapes your legend—will you rise or break under the pressure?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Are you ready to protect your city? In Superhero Simulator, take on the rising crime rate as you patrol the streets, stop robberies, rescue civilians, and battle powerful villains. Your choices shape the city! 

SAVE THE CITY

Stop robberies, rescue civilians, and fight crime your way. Every heroic act unlocks new abilities - become the hero Goldpine needs!

MANAGE YOUR DAILY NEEDS

Being a hero doesn’t pay the bills—so you’ll need a job to survive. Drive a taxi, flip burgers, or find other ways to earn money Every "Gollar" counts, whether it’s for food, or upgrading your gear. Balance your heroic duties with everyday struggles.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR HERO

Design your perfect superhero AND civilian identity! Mix and match masks, capes, and armor sets to create your signature look. Your hero, your style, your legend.

RISE OR FALL

Manage your health, hygiene, mental state, and respect to stay at your best. Neglect them, and your journey becomes harder. Every action shapes your legend—will you rise or break under the pressure?
